subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Drafts, writes, edits and publishes own story of at least two paragraphs (ten or more sentences) with a title

show.line: Every story has a title. The title tells you what the story is mostly about. Let's pick good titles!

rounds.story: Neo found a wet puppy. She dried it and gave it milk. Now it follows her everywhere. Which title fits?
rounds.praise: Yes! The story is mostly about the puppy.

rounds.story: Sipho planted a seed. He watered it every day. Soon a tall sunflower grew. Which title fits?

rounds.prompt: A story about a boy who wins a race. Say a good title. The Big Race, or The Blue Hat?

rounds.story: Gogo bakes bread every Friday. The whole street smells it. Everyone buys a loaf. Who is the story mostly about?

rounds.prompt: Which title is written correctly, with capital letters?
rounds.praise: Yes! Important words in a title get capital letters.

rounds.story: Zinzi lost her lunch box. She looked everywhere at school. It was in the fridge at home! Which title fits?

rounds.prompt: Which comes first in a story book?

hints: Ask yourself, what is this story mostly about?
A good title is short and says the main idea.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! A story about a cat stuck in a tree. I will pick the title.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! There is no bicycle in that story. The Cat in the Tree fits better.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's think together. What is the story about? A cat in a tree. That is the title!

parent_line: Can pick a title that fits the main idea of a short story.
